# Test footage input

Place original camera test clips here when convenient. The project uses S-Log3
footage converted by a LUT on an adjustment layer.

A small helpful set is 5-10 seconds of each:

- Skin or an ordinary scene with midtones and texture.
- Bright lamps, windows or specular reflections for halation and bloom.
- A dark scene with shadow detail for grain response.

One clip is enough to start. Include the conversion LUT and a note identifying
the camera gamut and intended output color space if known. Keep camera originals
unaltered. Synthetic tests can be used until footage is supplied.

Host test projects will be new disposable files under tests/host-projects.
Rendered results belong in tests/outputs. Creating these folders does not mean
an Adobe host project or plugin has already been built or tested.
